name: SentryWall 3200
shortDesc: Mid-size branch firewall appliance with integrated SD-WAN
longDesc: The SentryWall 3200 is a 1U branch-office firewall appliance combining stateful inspection, intrusion prevention, and integrated SD-WAN routing. Designed for distributed sites with up to 500 users, it delivers 4.5 Gbps of inspected throughput and supports zero-touch provisioning via SentryWall Central Manager.
features: Stateful inspection & intrusion prevention|Integrated SD-WAN routing|Zero-touch provisioning|4.5 Gbps inspected throughput

name: SentryWall 7400
longDesc: The SentryWall 7400 is a high-density data center firewall appliance delivering 40 Gbps of inspected throughput with hardware-accelerated TLS decryption. Built for campus cores and data center edges, it supports active-active clustering and VXLAN-aware segmentation.
features: Hardware-accelerated TLS decryption|Active-active clustering|VXLAN-aware segmentation|40 Gbps inspected throughput

name: SentryWall Virtual Edition
shortDesc: Virtual firewall image for private and public cloud
longDesc: SentryWall Virtual Edition packages the full SentryWall inspection engine as a virtual appliance for VMware, KVM, AWS, Azure, and GCP. Supports auto-scaling groups and infrastructure-as-code deployment via the SentryWall Terraform provider.
features: Multi-cloud deployment (AWS/Azure/GCP/VMware/KVM)|Auto-scaling group support|Terraform provider|Same inspection engine as hardware

name: SentryWall Central Manager
shortDesc: Centralized policy and logging console for SentryWall fleets
longDesc: SentryWall Central Manager is a self-hosted console for centralized policy authoring, firmware rollout, and log aggregation across an entire fleet of SentryWall appliances and virtual instances, with role-based change approval workflows.
features: Centralized policy authoring|Fleet-wide firmware rollout|Log aggregation|Role-based change approval workflows

name: Aegis Endpoint Protection
shortDesc: Per-seat next-gen antivirus and behavioral endpoint protection
longDesc: Aegis Endpoint Protection combines signature-based antivirus, machine-learning malware detection, and behavioral ransomware protection in a single lightweight agent for Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints, with cloud-managed policy and one-click rollback.
features: Real-time threat detection|Ransomware rollback & remediation|Behavioral ML malware detection|Cross-platform agent (Windows/macOS/Linux)|Cloud-managed policy

name: Aegis Mobile Agent
shortDesc: iOS and Android mobile threat defense agent
longDesc: Aegis Mobile Agent extends endpoint protection to iOS and Android devices, detecting jailbreak/root status, malicious profiles, and network-based phishing attempts, with MDM-integrated enrollment for corporate device fleets.
features: Jailbreak & root detection|Malicious profile detection|Network-based phishing protection|MDM-integrated enrollment

name: Argus XDR
shortDesc: Extended detection and response platform correlating endpoint, network, and cloud telemetry
longDesc: Argus XDR correlates telemetry from endpoints, network sensors, and cloud workloads into a unified detection timeline, using behavioral analytics and threat intelligence enrichment to surface high-confidence incidents and automate containment playbooks.
features: Cross-telemetry correlation (endpoint/network/cloud)|Automated containment playbooks|Threat intelligence enrichment|Unified detection timeline

name: Argus XDR Forensics Add-on
shortDesc: Deep forensic timeline reconstruction and threat hunting workbench add-on for Argus XDR
longDesc: The Forensics Add-on unlocks full historical telemetry retention, process-tree timeline reconstruction, and a guided threat-hunting workbench on top of Argus XDR, intended for dedicated SOC and incident response teams.
features: Full historical telemetry retention|Process-tree timeline reconstruction|Guided threat-hunting workbench

name: Meridian SASE
shortDesc: Secure access service edge combining SWG, CASB, and ZTNA
longDesc: Meridian SASE unifies secure web gateway, cloud access security broker, and zero-trust network access into a single cloud-delivered service, enforcing consistent policy for remote and office users without backhauling traffic through a data center.
features: Secure web gateway|Cloud access security broker (CASB)|Zero-trust network access (ZTNA)|No backhaul required

name: Meridian Remote Access Client
shortDesc: Downloadable client for Meridian SASE secure remote access
longDesc: The Meridian Remote Access Client establishes a lightweight, always-on secure tunnel to the nearest Meridian SASE point of presence, with posture checks that gate access based on device compliance before granting application access.
features: Always-on secure tunnel|Automatic point-of-presence failover|Device posture checks

name: BastionSIEM Connector
shortDesc: Log forwarding and normalization connector for BastionSIEM analytics
longDesc: The BastionSIEM Connector collects, normalizes, and forwards logs from on-premises infrastructure into the BastionSIEM analytics platform, with prebuilt parsers for common firewall, endpoint, and identity provider log formats.
features: Prebuilt log parsers|Multi-source log normalization|Real-time log forwarding

name: Sentinel Mail Security
shortDesc: Cloud email security with phishing and BEC protection
longDesc: Sentinel Mail Security inspects inbound and outbound mail flow for phishing, business email compromise, and malicious attachments using computer-vision brand-impersonation detection and sender behavior baselining, deployed inline via API integration with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace.
features: Phishing & BEC detection|Computer-vision brand-impersonation detection|Sender behavior baselining|Microsoft 365 & Google Workspace integration

name: Sentinel Mail Archiving Add-on
shortDesc: Compliant email archiving and e-discovery add-on for Sentinel Mail Security
longDesc: The Archiving Add-on retains a tamper-evident copy of all mail flow processed by Sentinel Mail Security for regulatory retention periods, with a searchable e-discovery console for legal hold and compliance export requests.
features: Tamper-evident mail retention|Searchable e-discovery console|Legal hold support

name: CloudWarden CSPM
shortDesc: Cloud security posture management across AWS, Azure, and GCP
longDesc: CloudWarden CSPM continuously scans AWS, Azure, and GCP accounts for misconfigurations, excess permissions, and drift from compliance frameworks (CIS, SOC 2, PCI DSS), with guided and one-click remediation for common findings.
features: Multi-cloud misconfiguration scanning|Compliance framework mapping (CIS/SOC 2/PCI DSS)|One-click remediation|Excess permission detection

name: IronGate VPN Concentrator 500
shortDesc: Site-to-site and remote access VPN concentrator appliance
longDesc: The IronGate VPN Concentrator 500 terminates up to 10,000 concurrent site-to-site and remote-access IPsec/TLS tunnels, with hardware crypto acceleration and active-passive high availability failover.
features: 10000 concurrent IPsec/TLS tunnels|Hardware crypto acceleration|Active-passive HA failover

name: Vantage Threat Intelligence Feed
shortDesc: Curated indicator-of-compromise and threat actor intelligence feed
longDesc: The Vantage Threat Intelligence Feed delivers curated, deduplicated indicators of compromise and threat actor profiles via STIX/TAXII, enriched with confidence scoring and designed for direct ingestion into SIEM and SOAR platforms.
features: Curated IOC & threat actor feed|STIX/TAXII delivery|Confidence scoring|Direct SIEM/SOAR ingestion
